card.name: Word after dose in dose-comparison phrases
card.fires_on: Mostly the word right after "dose" or a dose noun, as in "recommended human dose" or "dose reduction in". It also fires weakly on scattered words in general web prose.

card.writes: It seems to suppress words like "regarding" and "relevant", so the next word is less likely to be a linking word of that kind.
card.plain: It marks the word that follows "dose" in phrases like "human dose" or "dose reduction in", and it fires weakly on other prose.
